purpose: Retrospective evaluation of the PER-NORTE-01 corridor without changing rules after observing validation results.

time_splits.rule: No parameter changes after inspecting validation or holdout scores.

depth_definitions.rule: The 300 km threshold is primary. Results using 200 km must be labeled exploratory and reported separately.

corridor_distance_bands_km.rule: All bands must be reported; do not select only the best result.

benchmarks.name: HISTORICAL_RATE
benchmarks.description: Historical event rate in the same evaluation region and time window.

benchmarks.name: RECENT_ACTIVITY_PERSISTENCE
benchmarks.description: Forecast based only on recent seismic activity, without transfer-pressure routes.

benchmarks.name: AREA_MATCHED_CONTROL
benchmarks.description: Control region with area comparable to the corridor evaluation region.

reporting_rules: Report all forecasts, including unsuccessful forecasts.
Report all target events, including events outside the corridor.
Do not change PER-NORTE-01 V1 during replay.
Do not create S01-S04 segments unless an independent method is validated.
Do not interpret retrospective results as an operational warning capability.
warning_text: Modelo experimental. No constituye una alerta oficial, una prediccion determinista ni sustituye la informacion del IGP/CENSIS y otras autoridades competentes.
